question: Neurovascular assessment should be performed after joint reduction but is not required before reduction because it does not change the management decision.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: This is false. Both pre-reduction AND post-reduction neurovascular assessments are mandatory. Pre-reduction assessment establishes a baseline: if a sciatic palsy is present before hip reduction, it cannot be attributed to the reduction manoeuvre. Always document pulse, motor, and sensation before and after.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Correct — this is false. Pre-reduction neurovascular assessment is mandatory. It documents the baseline status so that any post-reduction neurological deficit can be correctly attributed (pre-existing vs caused by reduction). A nerve palsy documented before reduction has different medicolegal and clinical implications than one that appears after.
